turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen find out on his phone?
I don't think this is productive.
Productive. My son got a zero before anyone called me, so answer the question.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. Sit down and tell me what you have, or I walk straight to the principal's office.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I won't email anyone. Who decided, and on what basis?
